label: D2-R2 RUNG-COMPRESSION CELL (the pre-registered INSTRUMENT-FIX SUCCESSOR to the U-UNREADABLE track_d2_prep first attempt on band 141000000000): two deck-paired cells on ONE band and the SAME 200 decks. CELL R800 = frozen fair PIMC probe (k4x1032, tie-arbiter OFF, CHAMPION curve125 leaf a36d2e15a3b3d71d injected in-process via --cand-leaf-json) vs HeuristicMCTS(h800, c=3.0); CELL R1600 = the identical probe vs HeuristicMCTS(h1600, c=3.0). The two invocations differ in EXACTLY ONE experimental argument, --rung-sims. PRIMARY = deck-paired S = M_R800 - M_R1600 in pts/game with its z, testing whether the ladder's h800->h1600 spacing is a usable, non-compressed unit at this rung.
notes: NOT YET CLAIMED -- drafted for the orchestrator to append verbatim once the pair is blind-committed and owner-authorized (DESIGN.md section 0). Seeds 144000000000..144000000199 (200 decks x 2 seatings = 400 games PER CELL, 800 games total; ONE deck set shared by both cells). CRN across the two cells is DELIBERATE and the primary statistic is the deck-paired difference of margins S = M_R800 - M_R1600, not either cell's absolute reading alone. NOT POOLABLE with band 141000000000 -- that band's run adjudicated U-UNREADABLE on four instrument gates and NO statistic from it is carried, quoted, or compared here; it is also a different band, and CL-068 measured 1.8-2.2x cross-band over-dispersion on comparable contrasts. The DESIGN section 9 pilot uses a DISJOINT throwaway seed range, 144999999000..144999999007 (8 decks, CELL R800 config only), discarded, never pooled, never itself claimed as a row. The probe budget k4x1032 is the section 9 pilot's ONE permitted --sims re-pick, taken on the FIRST attempt's discarded pilot band before any cell ran and therefore before any statistic existed; it carries into this successor as an execution-layer value and the re-pick allowance is now exhausted. Stated prior, recorded before game 1 and unchanged from the first attempt: two prior readings of the nominal h800->h1600 spacing disagree by 2.8x -- CL-023 (measurement/level2/LEVEL2_LADDER_VERDICT.md, +55.2 +/- 17.6 elo, paired z 3.23, band 3.0e9+) vs experiments/results.csv row l22_ctrl_heur1600_vs_heur800_b310_n400 (+20.0 elo, sigma 17.4, z 3.285, band 3.10e9). This band's purpose is to resolve that contradiction within one band, deck-paired, at a fixed knob set (both rungs at UCT c=3.0 -- DESIGN section 2 shows there was never a c=1.5 rung, so no exploration-constant arm is carried). Once appended for real, band identity is load-bearing per CLAUDE.md and this band retires from confirmatory use once it has influenced a decision.
